crumble.target: Visible eligible ruin, obstruction or magical Wall
crumble.effect: Removes a 1.5″ strip through the obstruction; destroys a conjured Wall completely.
crumble.duration: Permanent terrain change. Figures above a removed surface may fall; protected scenario structures are excluded.

decay.target: Visible other figure's nonmagical weapon, normally within 24″
decay.effect: Destroys the selected weapon. The figure switches to another usable weapon or fights unarmed.
decay.duration: Permanent for the battle. Natural, unarmed and magical weapons cannot be selected.

fast_act.target: Visible unactivated ally or neutral creature, within 24″
fast_act.effect: Queues the target for early activation on your side.
fast_act.duration: This turn; not the caster, a previously activated figure or a member of an ongoing group.

fleet_feet.duration: Ongoing until removed or battle ends.

petrify.effect: Will resistance on casting; failure gives −3 Fight (minimum 0) and causes the target to skip an activation.
petrify.duration: The skip clears after the activation; the Fight penalty remains until removed. Large targets gain +8 on resistance.

slow.effect: Restricts the target to one action per activation.
slow.duration: Target may resist against casting result after each activation. Affects action economy rather than Move.

time_store.target: Self; both actions unused, outside group activation
time_store.effect: Stores an action for later use and ends this activation.
time_store.duration: Use the stored action when permitted on a later activation; cannot store another while one is held.

time_walk.effect: Allows the wizard to act again in apprentice and soldier phases.
time_walk.duration: This turn only. Consecutive-turn use deals 8 damage to the wizard.

call_storm.effect: Adds one point to the global shooting penalty, to a maximum of 5.
call_storm.duration: Ongoing; Dispel or Spell Eater can remove one casting.

destructive_sphere.effect: Direct magical +5 attacks against every nearby figure, including allies.
destructive_sphere.duration: Immediate. No line of sight required by the current area implementation.

elemental_ball.effect: Makes separate +5 elemental shooting attacks against target and figures within 1″ of it that are visible from it. Combat participants may also be affected.
elemental_ball.duration: Immediate; friendly fire possible. Each affected figure defends separately.

elemental_bolt.effect: +7 magical elemental shooting attack; target defends and armour reduces damage.
elemental_bolt.duration: Immediate; shooting into combat may redirect the attack.

elemental_hammer.effect: Enhances the figure's active weapon with elemental damage and magical attacks.
elemental_hammer.duration: Ongoing until removed. Applies to the ranged weapon if carried, otherwise the melee weapon.

elemental_shield.effect: Absorbs up to 3 incoming damage in total.
elemental_shield.duration: Lasts until depleted or dispelled. Not an Armour bonus.

scatter_shot.target: Self; visible opposing or neutral figures within 12″
scatter_shot.effect: Makes a separate +0 magical shooting attack against each eligible figure.
scatter_shot.duration: Immediate; combat targeting may redirect individual shots.

wall.target: Legal visible placement; at least part within 10″
wall.effect: Creates a 6″ × 1″, 3″-high obstruction that blocks movement and sight; top is climbable. Rotate before placing.
wall.duration: From the turn after creation, disappears on a turn-end d20 roll of 1–4; may be dispelled or crumbled.

animate_construct.effect: Adds a permanent construct companion to the roster on success.
animate_construct.duration: Small uses normal casting number; medium −3 to roll, large −6. Subject to roster and campaign limits.

control_construct.effect: Target tests Will against casting result. Failure transfers control to the caster's side.
control_construct.duration: Ongoing control; may be released or dispelled.

embed_enchantment.target: Campaign aftermath; select an eligible enchanted reward
embed_enchantment.effect: Makes the selected eligible enchantment permanent through the campaign reward system.
embed_enchantment.duration: One eligible ritual attempt per caster per preparation/aftermath cycle; not a battle action.

enchant_armour.target: Visible soldier with base Armour 11 or more, within 24″
enchant_armour.effect: +1 Armour, respecting the usual noncreature Armour cap of 15.
enchant_armour.duration: Ongoing until removed; cannot apply twice to the same figure.

enchant_weapon.effect: Enchants its ranged weapon if present, otherwise melee weapon; the attack counts as magical and gains combat benefits.
enchant_weapon.duration: Ongoing. A separate Enchant Ammunition choice applies to eligible friendly bow/crossbow users.

grenade.effect: Makes +3 shooting attacks on figures whose bases overlap the 1.5″ blast radius, including combat participants.
grenade.duration: Immediate; may affect allies as well as opponents.

telekinesis.effect: Move treasure up to 6″ to a legal visible location along a visible path.
telekinesis.duration: Immediate. Museum treasure and untouched central treasure are excluded; Planar Sinkhole limits displacement to 3″.

beauty.effect: Ordinary hostile warband figures must pass a Will test against casting result before targeting the caster.
beauty.duration: Ongoing; failed tests prevent targeting for that turn. Creatures and true sight can bypass this.

blink.effect: Displaces target up to 4″ in a randomly selected direction, stopping at obstructions. Enemy may resist.
blink.duration: Immediate. Red King gear can extend to 6″ or alter the direction.

fools_gold.effect: Choose a legal drop point within 4″. Target must resist or drop the selected treasure there.
fools_gold.duration: Immediate; illusionist staff can increase drop distance to 6″.

glow.effect: Makes the target easier to hit with shooting attacks.
glow.duration: Ongoing until removed; does not directly inflict damage.

illusionary_soldier.target: Legal visible point within 2″ on caster's level; also campaign preparation
illusionary_soldier.effect: Creates an illusory friendly thug in battle; preparation can select an eligible soldier guise.
illusionary_soldier.duration: Usually one illusion per warband. True sight can remove illusions; relevant staff can raise limit.

invisibility.effect: Conceals target from ordinary figure targeting.
invisibility.duration: Until revealed by fighting, casting or true sight, or dispelled. Area effects can still matter.

teleport.effect: Instantly moves caster to destination, ending its action sequence.
teleport.duration: Immediate. Must land legally; layered maps use their supported surface rules.

transpose.target: Two distinct visible figures, each within 24″ of caster and within 12″ of each other
transpose.effect: Swaps positions if the swap is legal and any required resistance fails.
transpose.duration: Immediate. Choose first figure, then second; no displacement if resistance or landing prevents it.

animate_skull.duration: One active skull per caster normally; skull staff and Golden Fang can change summon limits or bonuses.

bone_dart.effect: +5 shooting attack; target defends and armour reduces damage.
bone_dart.duration: Immediate. Current implementation does not treat it as an elemental or magical weapon attack; combat targeting may redirect it.

bones_of_the_earth.target: Visible non-large figure at ground level within 18″
bones_of_the_earth.duration: Ongoing until freed, moved by an applicable effect or dispelled. Cannot reapply to an already rooted figure.

control_undead.effect: Target tests Will against casting result. Failure transfers control to caster's side.
control_undead.duration: Ongoing; may be released or dispelled.

raise_zombie.target: Legal visible point within 1.25″ on caster's level; also campaign preparation
raise_zombie.effect: Creates a friendly zombie; preparation deploys it at the next battle.
raise_zombie.duration: Normally one per warband. Skull staff can increase limit and improve summon.

spell_eater.target: Select an eligible ongoing effect, normally within 24″
spell_eater.effect: Cancels the selected effect on success, like Dispel. Caster loses 1 Health when declaring the spell.
spell_eater.duration: Immediate; works on eligible figure effects, controlled creatures, conjured terrain, words and storm stacks.

steal_health.target: Visible opposing living nonconstruct figure within 24″
steal_health.effect: On failed Will resistance, target loses 3 Health and caster heals 3.
steal_health.duration: Immediate. Cannot target undead or constructs; healing is capped at maximum Health.

strike_dead.target: Visible other nonundead, nonconstruct figure within 8″
strike_dead.effect: Caster loses 1 Health on declaration. Target must resist or lose all remaining Health.
strike_dead.duration: Immediate. High casting number; resistance may be empowered where allowed.

absorb_knowledge.duration: Immediate campaign reward; cannot be cast in battle.

bridge.effect: Creates a traversable crossing between valid surfaces; rotate before casting.
bridge.duration: End of turn: disappears on 1–2. Extended Scroll can create a 9″ bridge with expiration on 1. Can be cancelled.

draining_word.target: Select a nonritual spell from the catalogue
draining_word.effect: Applies −3 to casting rolls of that named spell for all casters.
draining_word.duration: Ongoing until dispelled. One active word of this type per caster; cannot duplicate same word on same spell.

explosive_rune.effect: Places a trap. A figure whose base enters its 1″ trigger radius causes separate +5 magical direct attacks against figures overlapping the 2″ blast radius.
explosive_rune.duration: Remains until triggered, removed, or expires after caster is out of play (11+ at turn end). One per caster.

furious_quill.effect: −1 Move, −2 Fight, −4 Shoot and −2 casting modifier.
furious_quill.duration: Target attempts Will resistance at start of activation to remove it.

power_word.target: Select a nonritual spell from the catalogue
power_word.effect: +3 to casting rolls of that named spell for all casters.
power_word.duration: Ongoing until dispelled. One active word of this type per caster; cannot duplicate same word on same spell.

push.effect: Opposed d20 +10 versus target Fight and roll penalties. If attacker wins, pushes target a distance equal to attack total minus Armour (minimum 0).
push.duration: Immediate; ordinary Push inflicts no direct damage. Stops at obstructions; special gear can alter it.

write_scroll.target: Campaign aftermath; select eligible known spell
write_scroll.effect: Creates an unassigned scroll for that spell on success.
write_scroll.duration: Consumable campaign reward; no Health empowerment of the ritual.

awareness.effect: Prepares the caster's Awareness benefit for the coming battle.
awareness.duration: Preparation flag; cannot cast in battle.

mind_control.effect: Failed Will resistance transfers control to caster's side.
mind_control.duration: Target retests Will after each activation to break control. Mind Lock prevents or removes it.

mind_lock.effect: +2 Will; prevents Mind Control and releases existing Mind Control.

reveal_secret.effect: Adds one revealed-secret preparation reward for the upcoming battle.
reveal_secret.duration: Before battle only; affects scenario treasure preparation.

suggestion.target: Visible other figure within 24″ not protected by Mind Lock
suggestion.effect: Choose destination up to 3″ from target. On failed Will resistance it drops carried treasure and moves there.
suggestion.duration: Immediate. Legal landing and no falling damage required.

true_sight.effect: Reveals invisible figures and removes illusionary soldiers within 6″; nearby allies can see through invisibility.
true_sight.duration: Ongoing; the visibility sweep also runs after relevant moves and casts.

wizard_eye.effect: Places a remote viewpoint. Subsequent eligible spells can use its outward sight line and measure range from it.
wizard_eye.duration: One eye per caster; replacing or destroying supporting terrain removes the previous eye.

control_demon.effect: Failed Will resistance transfers control to caster's side.
control_demon.duration: Ongoing; cannot control another when already controlling one or when preparation reserves the slot.

imp.target: Legal visible placement at least 4″ from all figures
imp.effect: Summons an uncontrolled imp that acts as a creature, not a friendly soldier.
imp.duration: One per caster; recasting removes the old imp.

leap.target: Visible friendly figure or self within 24″
leap.effect: Choose legal landing up to 10″ away, or 5″ when carrying treasure. Jumps over low obstacles and ends the target's activation.
leap.duration: Immediate; illegal arcs, rooted or petrified targets excluded.

plague_of_insects.effect: Affected figures suffer −4 Fight (minimum 0) and −2 casting rolls; nearby susceptible figures can also be affected.
plague_of_insects.duration: Target retests Will at activation end. Large figures, undead and constructs are immune.

planar_tear.effect: Figures overlapping a 2″ radius make Will resistance tests. On failure demons take damage equal to casting result, other figures take 2.

plane_walk.effect: Drops treasure, removes rooting, becomes untargetable and may move through ordinary obstructions using legal landing points.
plane_walk.duration: Ends at turn end. Consecutive-turn attempts incur −5 per previous consecutive attempt, capped at −15.

possess.target: Visible allied noncaster, nondemon, outside group activation within 24″
possess.effect: +2 Fight, +1 Armour, −2 Will; counts as a demon.
possess.duration: Ongoing; only one possessed ally per caster, vulnerable to demon-targeting spells.

summon_demon.target: Legal visible point within 2″ on caster's level; also campaign preparation
summon_demon.effect: Creates a controlled imp; margin ≥6 above TN creates minor demon, ≥13 major demon. Natural 1 releases an uncontrolled demon.
summon_demon.duration: One controlled demon per caster. Exceptional empowerment ceiling; a prepared demon occupies the control slot.

banish.effect: Each demon tests Will. Failure destroys Will ≤4 demons; stronger demons lose 3 Health per point of failure.
banish.duration: Immediate; affects friendly demons as well.

blinding_light.effect: Target resists on casting. Failure sets Fight to 0, Move to 1 and prevents most non-touch spells.
blinding_light.duration: Target retests Will at turn end to recover.

circle_of_protection.target: Legal ground placement within 2″ on caster's level
circle_of_protection.effect: Creates a 3″-diameter ward that blocks undead and demons from entering.
circle_of_protection.duration: Ends on a turn-end roll of 1–3 or when removed. Cannot place over an existing eligible enemy.

destroy_undead.effect: Target tests Will. Failure destroys Will ≤2 undead; stronger undead lose 3 Health per point of failure.

dispel.target: Select an eligible ongoing effect, normally within 24″
dispel.effect: Cancels one ongoing spell effect, elemental shield, control effect, magical terrain, word effect or storm stack.
dispel.duration: Immediate. Does not undo instantaneous damage or completed movement.

heal.target: Visible wounded living nonconstruct figure or self within 6″
heal.effect: Restores up to 5 Health, capped at target's maximum.
heal.duration: Immediate. Cannot heal undead or constructs with this spell.

miraculous_cure.target: Campaign aftermath; choose eligible injured or dead member
miraculous_cure.effect: Revives the member and clears permanent injury records on success.
miraculous_cure.duration: −4 casting modifier if target is dead; no battle casting.

shield.duration: Ongoing until removed; unlike Elemental Shield, does not deplete after damage.

animal_companion.effect: Adds a permanent animal companion to the roster, associated with the caster.
animal_companion.duration: Subject to campaign eligibility and companion limits; not a battle spell.

brew_potion.effect: Creates selected potion in unassigned loot on success.
brew_potion.duration: Greater potions cost ingredients and impose −4 to casting roll. Ingredients spent on attempt.

control_animal.effect: Failed Will resistance transfers control to caster's side.
control_animal.duration: Ongoing; may be released or dispelled.

curse.effect: −2 to rolls affected by the figure's roll penalty (such as combat and casting).
curse.duration: Target retests Will at turn end; can combine with wound penalty.

familiar.effect: Prepares the caster's familiar for subsequent deployment.
familiar.duration: Campaign preparation; not a battle action.

fog.effect: Creates 6″ × 1″, 3″-high fog that blocks sight but allows movement. Rotate before placing.
fog.duration: Disappears on 1–4 at turn end or when dispelled.

mud.effect: Creates a circular 6″-diameter area of rough ground: movement through it costs double.
mud.duration: Ongoing until removed; not a direct damage spell.

poison_dart.effect: +3 shooting attack; if target loses Health, poisons it, restricting it to one action per activation.
poison_dart.duration: Immediate attack, ongoing poison until cured. Combat targeting may redirect it.
